source.note: For Soccer's 2026 review lists BJC Healthcare on St. Louis City SC's right sleeve (Apple TV on the left). The deal dates to the club's 2022 announcement, which put BJC on the First Team jersey's right sleeve (see deal st-louis-city-bjc-healthcare-sleeve).

summary: All MLS clubs wear Adidas; Apple TV is on the left sleeve of every kit. Purina fronts the jersey and BJC HealthCare sits on the right sleeve.
